name: Demons running away from a woman on a deer riding through a field of crosses
note: Type-metal relief engraving by Posada, hand printed by José Sanchez. The Met record in the search results describes this composition; I couldn't load the page, so date, dimensions and accession number are unconfirmed. Another impression is catalogued as 'Ilustración para un Cuento' in the 1942 portfolio '25 Prints of Jose Guadalupe Posada'.
credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York (accession number not confirmed)
